sources.title: Automata and Coinduction (An Exercise in Coalgebra)
sources.author: J. J. M. M. Rutten
sources.read_scope: Primary full text retrieved. Sections 2-4 definitions/derivatives/coinduction; section 7 finality, minimality and explicit Myhill-Nerode correspondence; section 13 partial automata.
sources.parent_result: Final behavior map identifies bisimilar states; generated language-derivative automaton is minimal. Partial automata bisimulation also preserves transition definedness.
sources.adaptation: Use arbitrary state observations and edge output/cost labels, with all intermediate events and illegal termination recorded. Prove concrete constructor-based response congruence and quotient in Lean.
sources.limits: Classical accepted-language semantics alone does not expose all partial enabledness; preserve defined paths too. No stochastic or nondeterministic trace-to-bisimulation implication imported.

sources.title: Universal coalgebra: a theory of systems
sources.author: J. J. M. M. Rutten
sources.publication: CWI CS-R9652; journal version Theoretical Computer Science249 (2000),3-80
sources.read_scope: Primary 1996 report retrieved, PDF pages26-29: isomorphism/factorization and simple-system results. Text extraction partially garbles mathematical glyphs; exact V8 claims are proved locally and supported by clear 1998 source.
sources.parent_result: Coalgebra quotients by bisimulation, homomorphism factorization, and greatest-bisimulation quotient simplicity.
sources.adaptation: Functor shape O × (Option(E × S))^A; no claim to construct a final object for all conceivable intelligence processes.
sources.limits: Set-indexed types and fixed observations. The quotient for a supplied machine is not a proof that this observation contract models reality.

sources.title: Finite-State Transducers in Language and Speech Processing
sources.author: Mehryar Mohri
sources.read_scope: Author-hosted corrected full text retrieved; sequential-transducer definitions pages2-3 and pushing/minimization pages27-28.
sources.parent_result: Weighted subsequential minimization uses weight pushing followed by automata minimization, under the stated semiring/model assumptions; pushing preserves realized completed-path function.
sources.adaptation: V8 keeps operational edge labels, hence ordinary stable partition refinement applies directly without weight pushing.
sources.limits: Redistributing a completed-path weight can change observed prefix costs and budget-enabledness; weighted-function equivalence is not our equivalence.

sources.title: Weighted Finite-State Transducer Algorithms: An Overview
sources.author: Mehryar Mohri
sources.read_scope: Author-hosted primary full text retrieved; preliminaries and weight-pushing/minimization discussion, pages6-8 also read by root reviewer.

sources.adaptation: Declare one deterministic path per input and additive Nat operational resources; preserve individual edge costs.
